extra.message: Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI): User-controlled input from request.GET['fragment'] is rendered directly in a Jinja2 template. An attacker can execute arbitrary code using payloads like {{ ''.__class__.__mro__[1].__subclasses__() }}.

cwe: CWE-94: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')

extra.message: Path traversal vulnerability: User-controlled input from request.GET['name'] is used to construct a file path without validation. An attacker can write arbitrary files using '../' sequences to escape the intended directory.
